gloss: every nook and cranny; every corner

definitions.gloss: every nook and cranny; every corner; all corners
definitions.explanation: Every part of a space, area, or organization, including the most remote or overlooked parts. Emphasizes thoroughness and completeness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅々|すみずみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I cleaned every corner of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅々|すみずみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{知|し}り→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{尽|つ}くしている→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。
examples.english: I know every nook and cranny of this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅々|すみずみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The police searched every corner of the building, but no evidence was found.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with the particle ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ to mean "all the way to every corner." The reduplicated form emphasizes thoroughness. Can refer to physical spaces, geographic areas, or abstract domains like organizations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隅々|すみずみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to clean every corner)
- {隅々|すみずみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{行|い}き{届|とど}く→行き届く：30420_ikitodoku⟧ (to reach every corner)
- {隅々|すみずみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{目|め}を{配|くば}る→目を配る：30621_mewokubaru⟧ (to keep an eye on every detail)
- ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅々|すみずみ} (every corner of the country)
